NutritionCycle.19: Gxila ku-protein engenamafutha amaningi nasezimbalini ezintsha.
NutritionCycle.25: Sekela isistimu yakho yezinzwa futhi unciphise ukuvuvukala.
NutritionCycle.27: Ubhontshisi, isipinashi, inyama engenamafutha amaningi, ubhontshisi be-chickpea.
NutritionCycle.29: Ama-alimondi, imbewu yethanga, ushokoledi omnyama, ubhanana.
NutritionCycle.33: Amaqanda, i-tofu, inyama yenkukhu, iyogathi yesi-Greek, i-quinoa.
NutritionCycle.41: Zijabulele ngokulinganisela ukuze usize ukugcina ukulingana kwakho.
NutritionCycle.45: I-salmon, i-quinoa, i-broccoli eshisiwe ngomoya, namafutha e-olive
NutritionCycle.47: Iyogathi engenashukela, amajikijolo e-blueberry, nembewu yeflaksi
NutritionCycle.49: Isobho likabhontshisi, imifino ethosiwe ovenini, nesinkwa sokolweni oluphelele
NutritionCycle.50: Ukudla nomjikelezo wakho: lokho umzimba wakho ukuthandayo — AWA

Ovulation.6: Isikhathi esiyisihluthulelo somjikelezo wakho, nendlela yokusibona.
Ovulation.12: Ukukhipha iqanda ukukhululwa kweqanda yinye yamaqanda esibeletho. Ngokuvamile kwenzeka cishe izinsuku ezingu-14 ngaphambi kokuya kwakho esikhathini okulandelayo, kungakhathaliseki ubude bonke bomjikelezo wakho.
Ovulation.14: Usuku lokuya kwakho esikhathini okulandelayo lulona oluhluka kwesinye isifazane nakwesinye, kakhulu kunesikhathi esiphakathi kokukhipha iqanda nokufika kwalo.
Ovulation.15: Ezinye izimpawu zomzimba zingahambisana nokusondela kokukhipha iqanda, ngezinga elihlukile kuye ngesifazane.
Ovulation.17: Njengoba ukukhipha iqanda kusondela, ubumanzi bomlomo wesibeletho buba bucacile, buyalulama futhi buyaqina.
Ovulation.18: Ubuhlungu obuncane ohlangothini olulodwa lwesisu esingezansi ("mittelschmerz")
Ovulation.20: Ukwenyuka okuncane kwezinga lokushisa komzimba ngesikhathi sokuphumula ngemva kokukhipha iqanda
Ovulation.22: Ukubuka lezi zimpawu emijikelezweni eminingana kukusiza ukuthi uzazi isigqi sakho siqu, esingahluka kumaphesenti avamile.
Ovulation.24: Umjikelezo ongenakho ukukhipha iqanda ungenzeka ngezikhathi ezithile, ngaphandle kokuthi lokhu kuthathwe njengesizathu sokukhathazeka. Uma ukuya kwakho esikhathini kungabikho isikhathi eside noma ungaqiniseki, kunconywa iseluleko sezokwelapha.
Ovulation.26: Akukho uphawu olulodwa oluthembekile ngokuphelele ngokwalo: ukuluhlanganisa kunikeza umbono ongcono wesikhathi sakho sokuzala kakhulu.

Patch.6: Enye indlela yeviki lonke esikhundleni sepilisi lansuku zonke.
Patch.12: Iphepha likhulula ama-hormone njalo esikhumbeni, lisebenza ngendlela efana nepilisi elihlanganisiwe: livimbela ukukhipha iqanda futhi liqinisa ubumanzi bomlomo wesibeletho.
Patch.14: Inzuzo yalo eyinhloko ukuthi alidingi umthamo wansuku zonke.
Patch.15: Iphepha ngokuvamile lishintshwa kanye ngeviki izinsuku ezintathu, kulandelwe iviki elilodwa ngaphandle kwephepha.
Patch.19: Amaphuzu abalulekile ongawazi ngaphambi nangesikhathi sokusebenzisa.
Patch.27: Ukucasuka endaweni okufakwe kuyo kungase kwenzeke ngezikhathi ezithile.
Patch.38: Ukucasuka okuncane kungabonakala endaweni okufakwe kuyo. Ukushintshanisa izindawo zokufaka kungasiza ukukunciphisa.
Patch.42: Cela iseluleko sochwepheshe wezempilo uma kudingeka.
